Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection

Class Protections

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.Protections
public final class Protections extends Object
The permission checks applied before a bucket changes the world, expressed as the vanilla gates and loader events a player doing the same thing by hand would pass.

A real player gets vanilla's block-use gates (spawn protection, the world border, and the block-placement ability); automation gets only the world border. On the server, each check then posts the loader event for the action through BucketOperations: block break for removal, block place for placement, judged against the block actually placed through BucketOperations.placeChecked(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.core.Direction, net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState, java.util.function.BooleanSupplier), and item pickup for storage intake. Claim and protection mods observe those events.

A player's use of a clicked block (tanks, cauldrons, release against a block) or of an entity (capture, milking, feeding) reaches the item through vanilla dispatch, which has already posted the loader's block- or entity-interaction event, so only automation posts those here. Automation posts every event as the context's automation player, positioned at the dispenser and holding a copy of the bucket. The client applies the vanilla gates only; the server is authoritative.
